title: Arc reading is weak
summary: The player struggles to identify what a moving target or set of targets is about to do, so shot timing and cursor placement both suffer.
telltales: Readable arcs still feel visually confusing
The player can follow the target sometimes, but not predict the next movement cleanly
contraindications: Do not reduce this to only flick speed or click speed
avoid: Treating a reading-heavy pattern like a simple static timing task
